name: Memory latch (set / reset)
description: A bistable memory cell, after Levin's bioelectric pattern memory. The compartment (painted cell = 1) holds reagent m, which is stable at 0 and at 1 and mixes freely inside the membrane but can't leave it. The first glider crosses the set zone (b_to_m > 0) and switches the cell on; it stays on. A second glider, released later on the lower lane, crosses the reset zone (b_to_m < 0) and switches it off; it stays off. Shown as b tinted by m. Both gliders are the axis-locked kind, so they fly dead straight along their lanes.
